cards.name: clause-researcher
cards.description: Finds the clause in one contract that answers a question and reports it as executed, with its [CONTRACT-ID §N] label. Does not check amendments.

skills.name: Find a clause
skills.description: Given a contract id and a topic, returns the clause that covers it and the exact value it states, or says the contract has no such clause. Given no id, first finds the document that covers the topic.
examples: Contract PC-2026-027: what is the termination notice period?
Which document caps overseas players in the playing eleven, and at how many?

cards.name: amendment-checker
cards.description: Reports what the amendments to one contract changed: the sections they replace, the old and new values, and the [AMENDMENT-ID §N] label of each change. Does not search the contract itself.

skills.name: Check amendments
skills.description: Given a contract id and a topic, returns every amendment that changes that topic, with the replacing value, or says that no amendment changes it.
examples: Contract PC-2026-011: has the termination notice period been amended, and to what?
